description: This source file defines the IgnitionMapBuilder class, which provides static methods for calculating ignition timing parameters based on engine characteristics such as chamber style, octane, compression, bore, RPM, and manifold absolute pressure (MAP). It includes enumerations, calculation methods, and helper functions for interpolations and corrections related to ignition mapping.

classes.name: IgnitionMapBuilder
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for ignition timing calculations based on engine parameters.

classes.name: ChamberStyle
classes.description: Enumeration representing different combustion chamber styles with associated ignition advance values.

methods.name: getTopAdvanceForBore
methods.description: Calculates the top ignition advance based on chamber style, octane rating, compression ratio, and bore size.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs linear interpolation between two data points.

methods.name: getAdvanceForRpm
methods.description: Calculates ignition advance based on engine RPM and maximum advance.

methods.name: getInitialAdvance
methods.description: Computes initial ignition advance based on RPM, manifold pressure, and maximum advance.

methods.name: round10
methods.description: Rounds a double value to one decimal place.

methods.name: getBoreCorrection
methods.description: Calculates a correction factor based on bore size.
